reviews.review_text: The food very good but the attention of the Local Saltao de Refugio was regrettable, the cashier a disrespectful and bad-tempered person, I greeted her twice and she never responded, she did not say a word just collect and deliver the voucher like a machine
reviews.title: Poor care

reviews.review_text: Chilcanos in TAMARINDO, very good, classic and pineapple. Afterwards in CAJA CHINA CREOLE, we ordered pancetta accompanied by chaufa rice or potatoes, along with sauces, highly recommended
reviews.title: Assorted drink and meal options

reviews.review_text:
Refugio is a forest where Peruvian gastronomy is born and enchants you with everything it offers. The area for children and its services is amazing. The shows are phenomenal, the food is worth repeating every day since you have many options. The best of all is that you always have somewhere to sit. Simply spectacular.
Refugio is a jungle where Peruvian Gastronomic was born and bewiches you with everything it has. The children place and facilities are amazing. The music shows are spectacular, the food it's to repeat every day. Finally it's wonderfull when you have seat always.
reviews.title: Simply Extraordinary - Amazing Experience

reviews.review_text: Best place to have a nice time with friends, have some drinks listen to nice music and lot of options of really nice restaurants!!.....Also it has a Kids playground
reviews.title: Nice place for Food & Drinks for all ages
